home.subtitle: Privacy-focused, offline media converter.
home.dropzone: Select a file or drag it here

batch.title: Batch Conversion
batch.subtitle: Convert multiple files at the same time.
batch.pageSubtitle: Converts several files in sequence with the same settings. Each file is tracked separately; an error does not stop the queue.
batch.unsupported: "{name}" is not supported. Please choose a known media file.
batch.addSub: Video, audio and image files — you can select several

audioMerge.title: Audio Merge
audioMerge.subtitle: Merge multiple audio files into one.
audioMerge.pageSubtitle: Merges several audio files into one. Choose sequential (concat) or simultaneous (mix) mode.
audioMerge.unsupported: "{name}" is not supported. Only audio files can be added.
audioMerge.addHint: Add an audio file (click or drag)
audioMerge.addAria: Click or drag to add an audio file
audioMerge.audioExts: MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, OGG and more
audioMerge.mixDesc: Files play at the same time

videoMerge.title: Video Merge
videoMerge.subtitle: Concatenate multiple video files in order.
videoMerge.warning: ⚠️ Files should have the same codec and resolution.
videoMerge.pageSubtitle: Joins video files in order. Every file must share the same codec and resolution, otherwise stream copy can fail.
videoMerge.unsupported: "{name}" is not supported. Only video files can be added.
videoMerge.addVideoHint: Add a video file (click or drag)
videoMerge.info: ℹ️ Video merging runs in stream copy mode — nothing is re-encoded, so it is very fast. Every file must share the same codec (e.g. H.264) and audio format.

frames.title: Frame Extract
frames.subtitle: Extracts image frames from a video at fixed intervals. Handy for thumbnails or content analysis.
frames.dropSub: MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI and more
frames.info: A {format} frame will be extracted every {interval}s. Frames are saved to the -kareler/ folder.

gif.title: Create GIF
gif.subtitle: Produces a high-quality GIF from a video. The colour palette is computed automatically (palettegen + paletteuse); FPS and size are adjustable for low bandwidth.
gif.colorNote: Note: GIF is limited to 256 colours. For colour-rich videos prefer WebM or MP4.

apng.title: Create APNG
apng.subtitle: Produces an animated PNG from a video. Unlike GIF it supports a full colour palette (32-bit RGBA); transparency is preserved and quality is far higher. File size can be larger than GIF.
apng.vsGifDesc: APNG supports 32-bit color and alpha transparency; GIF is limited to 256 colors.
apng.browserNote: Unlike GIF, APNG supports 16 million colours and preserves alpha transparency. Browser support: Firefox, Chrome, Safari (all modern browsers including Edge).

pdf.title: PDF → Image
pdf.subtitle: Convert PDF pages to PNG, JPG or PPM images.
pdf.pageSubtitle: Extracts every PDF page as a separate image file. Requirement: pdftoppm must be installed (macOS: brew install poppler · Linux: apt install poppler-utils).
pdf.pickPdfHint: Select a PDF file (click or drag)
pdf.info: {dpi} DPI · {format} · Every page is extracted as its own file.
pdf.outDirNote: Output folder: PDF-name-sayfalar/ (next to the PDF).

multiOutput.title: Multi-Output Formats
multiOutput.subtitle: Produces several formats at once from a single input file. A separate output file is created for each selected profile.
multiOutput.selectHint: You can select more than one format.
multiOutput.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# format selected} other {# formats selected}}

trim.title: Video Trim
trim.subtitle: Cut a specific portion of a video.
trim.streamCopy: Fast trim (stream copy) — no re-encoding, instant
trim.streamCopyDesc: Cuts without re-encoding — fast but less precise.
trim.pageSubtitle: Trim a video or audio file by setting a start and end point.
trim.endAfterStart: The end time must be later than the start time.
trim.reencodeNote: Re-encoding takes longer but cuts land exactly on frame boundaries.

normalize.title: Audio Normalize
normalize.subtitle: Normalize audio levels to EBU R128 standard.
normalize.pageSubtitle: Balances loudness to the EBU R128 standard using FFmpeg's loudnorm filter.
normalize.avOnly: Please select an audio or video file.
normalize.pickAudioHint: Select an audio or video file (click or drag)
normalize.peakHint: −1.0 dBTP is recommended to avoid clipping
normalize.lraHint: Dynamic range width — 7-11 for music, 4-7 for speech

watermark.title: Add a Watermark
watermark.subtitle: Overlay a text or image watermark on a video file.
watermark.imageInvalid: Select a PNG, JPG or WebP image.

metadata.title: Edit Metadata
metadata.subtitle: Read and edit media file tags.
metadata.pageSubtitle: Edit a video or audio file's tags — title, artist, year and more.
metadata.pickMediaHint: Select a video or audio file (click or drag)
metadata.avOnly: Please select a video or audio file.
metadata.infoNote: Fields left empty keep their current values. The output keeps the original format (-c copy).

aspectRatio.title: Aspect Ratio Crop
aspectRatio.subtitle: Center-crops a video or image to the selected ratio. Re-encoding preserves quality.
aspectRatio.unsupported: Unsupported file type. Only video and image files are accepted.
aspectRatio.pickHint: Drag a video or image file here, or click
aspectRatio.pickSub: MP4, MKV, MOV, PNG, JPG, WebP and more

resolution.title: Resolution Scaling
resolution.subtitle: Resizes a video or image to the given width. The aspect ratio is preserved.
resolution.invalidWidth: Invalid width. Enter a value between 1 and 7680.

subtitle.title: Extract Subtitles
subtitle.subtitle: Exports the subtitle streams in a video file as SRT, ASS or VTT.
subtitle.noStreams: No subtitle stream found in this file.
subtitle.containerOnly: Only video containers are supported (MKV, MP4, TS, etc.).
subtitle.pickSub: MKV, MP4, TS and other containers carrying subtitle streams
subtitle.infoSrt: The most common format; text based, with limited timing and styling support.
subtitle.infoAss: Advanced styling and positioning support; common for anime subtitles.
subtitle.infoVtt: Built for web browsers; compatible with HTML5 video.
subtitle.infoNote: Note: if the source codec is not directly supported, FFmpeg converts it.
